about: Robinhood Chain mainnet (4663), read-only, 2026-10-13: every candidate token for the second list of the Tenonfi factory (docs/vault/MAINNET-WIDER-LIST.md), as packages/chain-evm/test/pool-quotes.ts read it. Pools are kept when they hold liquidity in range and charge 1% or less; the run listed the others too. Two runs, each at one block, through the node named by ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL (its host is not recorded).

runs.source: Uniswap v4 StateView 0xf3334192d15450cdd385c8b70e03f9a6bd9e673b and Quoter 0x8dc178efb8111bb0973dd9d722ebeff267c98f94 on Robinhood Chain (4663) through the node in ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL; pools listed through the node in ROBINHOOD_RPC_URL
runs.method: pool-quotes-0.2: hookless v4 pools against USDG; quoteExactInputSingle for $1,000, $2,500, $5,000, $10,000, $25,000, $50,000, $250,000 each way; cost in bps against the pool mid of the same block, fee included; pools of a fee above 1% listed and not quoted; the v3 pools of the token and USDG at fees 100, 500, 3000 and 10000 with their liquidity, observations kept and whether observe([3600, 0]) answers
